private theorem e849_choose_succ_lt (n r : ℕ) (h : 2 * (r + 1) ≤ n) : n.choose r < n.choose (r + 1) := by
  have e := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n r
  have hpos : 0 < n.choose r := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hlt : r + 1 < n - r := by omega
  by_contra hc
  have hc' : n.choose (r + 1) ≤ n.choose r := Nat.le_of_not_lt hc
  have h1 : n.choose (r + 1) * (r + 1) ≤ n.choose r * (r + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc'
  rw [e] at h1
  have h2 := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 hpos
  omega

private theorem e849_choose_lt_col (n r d : ℕ) (h : 2 * (r + d + 1) ≤ n) :
    n.choose r < n.choose (r + d + 1) := by
  induction d with
  | zero => simpa using e849_choose_succ_lt n r (by simpa using h)
  | succ d ih =>
    have h1 := ih (by omega)
    have h2 := e849_choose_succ_lt n (r + d + 1) (by omega)
    have e : r + (d + 1) + 1 = r + d + 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [e]; omega

private theorem e849_choose_lt (n k n' k' : ℕ) (hkk : k' < k) (hk : 2 * k ≤ n) (hn : n' ≤ n) :
    n'.choose k' < n.choose k := by
  have h1 : n'.choose k' ≤ n.choose k' := Nat.choose_le_choose k' hn
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, k = k' + d + 1 := ⟨k - k' - 1, by omega⟩
  have h2 := e849_choose_lt_col n k' d hk
  omega

private theorem e849_choose_lt_row (n n' k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hn : n < n') :
    n.choose k < n'.choose k := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have e : (n + 1).choose (j + 1) = n.choose j + n.choose (j + 1) := Nat.choose_succ_succ' n j
  have hpos : 0 < n.choose j := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have h2 : (n + 1).choose (j + 1) ≤ n'.choose (j + 1) := Nat.choose_le_choose _ (by omega)
